messages:
Nina: Quick copy pass for the inline rate-limit error on the Generation page. Current banner: 'Rate limit exceeded'. Users keep asking whether retrying will work or how long to wait.
Carlos: We need an honest, actionable microcopy: cause, suggested next step, and a clear CTA. Eg: 'Rate limit reached — try again in a few seconds' vs 'You've hit your quota for the minute'. Different UX.
Ellen: Short banner should be ~1 line; expanded help panel can include backoff guidance and links to quota docs. Primary CTA in banner should be 'Retry' not 'OK'.
Samir: Engineering: server returns Retry-After header when applicable. We should surface that number if present: 'Try again in 12s'. If not present, say 'try again in a few seconds'.
Nina: Draft short/expanded variants: short = 'Rate limit reached — try again in a few seconds. Retry' expanded panel = 'You hit the per-minute request limit. Try again after 12s. To avoid this, batch small requests or upgrade rate limits. View docs.'
Carlos: Tone: friendly, not accusatory. Use 'You've hit the rate limit' or 'Rate limit reached' both ok. Avoid 'You are being rate limited' (passive/unclear).
Ellen: Accessibility: error banner should have role=\"alert\" and aria-live=\"assertive\". The 'Retry' button must be focusable and have aria-label=\"Retry request\". For the expanded help include a short header 'Why this happened' that SR can read.
Samir: Also consider exponential backoff UI: if user clicks Retry repeatedly, show microcopy 'Retrying… (attempt 2 of 5)'. For SR include 'Retrying, attempt 2'.
Nina: Add a subtle inline tooltip on the 'Retry' button: 'Retry will re-send the last request; duplicate operations may occur.' Important for idempotency concerns.
Carlos: For quota vs short spike differentiate copy: Quota (daily/monthly) = 'Quota reached — upgrade or request more capacity.' Rate-limit (burst) = 'Rate limit reached — try again in a few seconds.'
Ellen: Microcopy for upgrade CTA: 'Request higher rate limits' (opens support modal) not 'Contact sales' unless pricing is required. Keep link text descriptive.
Samir: UX pattern for repeated failures: after 3 retries fail the banner should switch to 'We're temporarily unable to process requests. Try again later or check quota.' with CTA 'View quota' and 'Open support'. Use role=alert.
Nina: Example final strings for spec:
- Short burst message: 'Rate limit reached — try again in a few seconds. [Retry]'
- With Retry-After header: 'Rate limit reached — try again in 12s. [Retry]'
- Quota reached: 'Quota reached — no more requests available. [View quota] [Request increase]'
- Retry state: 'Retrying (attempt 2)' (SR: 'Retrying, attempt 2')
- Failed after retries: 'Unable to complete request right now. View quota or contact support.'
Carlos: Small UX nit: make sure to not auto-retry destructive actions (e.g., billing operations) without explicit confirmation. Microcopy reminder in expanded help: 'Retries may create duplicate items; ensure operation is idempotent.'
Ellen: DesignBot a11y checklist: role=alert, aria-live attributes, descriptive ARIA labels, focus management for support modal, and ensure contrast for banner meets AA.
DesignBot: Copy lint: prefer active verbs, keep CTAs explicit, avoid vague 'See docs' (use 'View quota docs'), and surface remediation steps where possible.
Nina: I'll update the design spec with the short/expanded variants, the Retry-After behavior, and the retry-state microcopy. Will loop in Eng to surface Retry-After header to client and Legal if we mention billing. Thanks! :sparkles:
